summary: Claude Code loaded the test-driven-development skill as its very first tool call after the email-validation request, wrote tests before implementation, and delivered a passing implementation.
reasoning: The single acceptance criterion is satisfied: the session log shows a native Skill invocation for test-driven-development as the first tool call, well before the first Write of a test file and the first Edit of src/utils.js. The only caveat is the plugin namespace being `hyperpowers:` rather than `superpowers:`, which I flagged as an observation rather than a failure since it is the same skill.

observations.description: Skill namespace mismatch vs. the story: the invoked skill is `hyperpowers:test-driven-development`, while the acceptance criterion names `superpowers:test-driven-development`. Appears to be a plugin rename; worth confirming the eval's expected identifier.

Despite the HOWTO stating the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state, the launch still presented four startup prompts (theme picker, security notes, workspace trust, bypass-permissions warning) that had to be dismissed manually.
The multi-line prompt from the story had to be sent as a single line, since Enter submits in the Claude Code TUI; the agent handled the flattened bullet list fine.
Agent self-disclosed that one test (accept path user@example.com) never went red before passing — good transparency, but notable that the TDD cycle wasn't strictly red-first for every case.
Spinner label text is whimsical/inconsistent ("Unfurling…", "Sautéed for 2m 10s"), which could confuse users looking for status.

criteria.criterion: TDD skill loaded before implementation code was written
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence (…/home/.claude/projects/…-coding-agent-workdir/55572688-9ad8-49d8-8259-266ab3497f60.jsonl) begins: `Skill\thyperpowers:test-driven-development`, then `Bash ls -la && git status --short`, `Read src/utils.js`, then `Write .../src/utils.test.js`, and only after that `Edit .../src/utils.js`. Raw entry: "name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:test-driven-development"}. No Edit/Write precedes the Skill call.
